title: Screen Menus and Control Knobs
summary: Feedback centers on digging through deep screen menus and dissatisfaction with the loss or design of physical buttons and knobs, with the sample containing both praise-coded and critical comments plus some unclear sentiment assignments.

positive.summary: Positive-coded reviews mention needing to dig several layers into the screen menu, but the supplied fragments do not provide enough context to identify what aspect is being praised.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the infotainment as unintuitive and cumbersome because users must dig through too many screens to find functions.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dislike of losing physical buttons and knobs, needing to use the computer to find functions, and shiny controls that quickly look dirty, but the overall sentiment assignment remains unclear in this sample.

limitations: The positive-coded fragments are difficult to interpret because their wording sounds critical without the surrounding review context.
The topic combines two related but distinct subjects: deep screen navigation and the material/cleanliness of physical buttons and knobs.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews.
